blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–Victoria Bossong’s first competition representing the Philippines ended with an Asian Games medal and a desire to wear the country’s colors on many more major stages. The 23-year-old Filipino-American took bronze in the women’s 800 meters at the 2026 Asian Games, clocking 2 minutes, 5.34 seconds at Nagoya City Mizuho Park Athletic Stadium. China’s Wu Hongjiao won gold in 2:04.49, while Bahrain’s Nelly Korir claimed silver in 2:05.16. Bossong, who became eligible to represent the Philippines in national representative competitions in July 2026, said competing under the Philippine flag added another dimension to her Asian Games debut.
